diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell (GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-). EBER negative; CD5 negative; no low-grade (follicular) component.
stage: Lugano (Ann Arbor) stage IA: a single nodal region (right cervical levels II-III, contiguous), with no B symptoms. Non-bulky: largest node 3.1 cm. No extranodal, splenic or marrow disease on PET-CT.
biology: Neither double-expressor nor double-hit. MYC 15% and BCL2 30% by IHC are below the 40%/50% thresholds. FISH negative. Ki-67 ~55%.
prognosis: IPI 0 of 5, low risk. CNS-IPI 0, low risk. FLYER-eligible.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy. Recommend R-CHOP for 4 cycles followed by 2 additional doses of rituximab, without radiotherapy (FLYER regimen).
cns_risk: Low CNS-relapse risk: CNS-IPI 0 and no high-risk extranodal sites. CNS prophylaxis is not indicated.
response_assessment: Interim PET-CT after 4 cycles of R-CHOP, before the two rituximab doses. End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT 6-8 weeks after the last dose, read with Lugano 2014 criteria and the Deauville 5-point scale.
pretreatment_workup: Urine pregnancy test negative today, before cycle 1. Hepatitis B serology done: HBsAg and anti-HBc nonreactive. HCV and HIV nonreactive. Echo LVEF 63%, so anthracycline is permitted.
supportive_care: Tumor lysis risk is low (normal LDH, uric acid and renal function); oral hydration. Primary G-CSF not routinely required. Antiemetics per regimen; avoid codeine (intolerance). Rituximab infusion-reaction precautions.
fitness_and_goals: Fit: ECOG 0 with no limiting comorbidity, so curative-intent therapy is appropriate.
missing_information: Confirmation that the combined oral contraceptive has actually been stopped and a non-estrogen method placed

decisions.diagnosis: DLBCL NOS, GCB type (Hans); not double-expressor, not double-hit
decisions.regimen: R-CHOP-21 x 4 cycles, then rituximab 375 mg/m2 x 2 doses (FLYER)
